title: Work Order 4350: T2 Bushing Insulation Test
body: Routine bushing insulation test on transformer TRF-0148 carried out per spec_trf_oil_v2, the governing standard at the time (v2 effective 2025-01-01, six-year test interval). Test passed. Oil dielectric strength measured 41 kV, within the v2 minimum of 40 kV.
